itens.trecho: Jogos Mortais X é o décimo filme da franquia de terror que começou em 2004 com o primeiro Jogos Mortais, dirigido por James Wan. O filme se passa entre os eventos do primeiro e do segundo filme, mostrando a vida pessoal e os motivos de John Kramer, o psicopata conhecido como Jigsaw, que cria armadilhas mortais para testar a vontade de viver de suas vítimas.

If it sounds too good to be true then it probably is. That's what "Kramer" (Tobin Bell) ought to have thought when he was presented with a miracle cure for his terminal cancer by "Cecilia" (Synnøve Macody Lund) for a mere $250k. Anyway, off he goes to Mexico and then quickly discovers that it was all a con.

I am sure you can read all the other reviews to get your spoilers, but I don't like to do that. So... The movie takes place during the time John is still trying to deal with the news of his impending death, and going through treatment options of his cancer.
